text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: prod-gateway (us-west-2): 5xx rate spike > 3x baseline over 5m. Alerts: gateway.tls_handshake_failures, gateway.5xx_rate. Pager: oncall-rotation

Elaine (oncall): I'm on it. Checking Gateway logs and cert status.

Elaine (oncall): Initial query: nginx shows repeated 'ssl_handshake_failure' and 'no shared cipher' across front proxy nodes.

Elaine (oncall): curl to edge returns "curl: (35) error:14077410:SSL routines:SSL23_GET_SERVER_HELLO:sslv3 alert handshake failure"

Elaine (oncall): Running openssl:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect gateway-usw2.redwood.example.com:443 -servername gateway.redwood.example.com
CONNECTED(00000003)
139724...:error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert certificate unknown:SSL alert number 46
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=gateway.redwood.example.com
   i:/CN=redwood-intermediate
---
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
```

Sanjay K: We've rotated the intermediate cert yesterday for the external CA — could be bad chain uploaded.

Elaine (oncall): Confirmed: intermediate cert expired on 1954319000 (approx 1h before spike). That's our rotation window.

Maria P (infra): I'm pulling the cert bundle from the vault now: `vault kv get secret/prod/tls/gateway`.

Maria P (infra): Vault shows intermediate with expiry 1954318999. Looks like the new intermediate didn't replace the old chain correctly on some hosts.

Rajeev (security): If some proxies are serving the old chain, clients that require full chain will fail handshake. On legacy clients this shows as 5xx.

Elaine (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Fail traffic to fallback pool (no TLS termination) 2) Re-deploy cert bundle to all front nodes 3) Gradual re-enable with canary. Executing now.

Elaine (oncall): Switching route policy to 'tls-terminate:delegate' on the gateway LB to push traffic to fallback nodes (low-latency but no edge TLS). Command:
```
# switch to fallback
rwctl route update --service prod-gateway --policy failover:fallback-pool
```

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Route change applied by Elaine at 1954321120. Error rates dropped ~60% within 2m.

SupportBot: Customer-impact: ~14% of requests (50k/min -> ~7k/min failing) across 3 orgs. Top affected customers: acme-corp, datawise. Open incidents created in Zendesk.

Sanjay K: I'm starting a rolling cert upload job to the remaining nodes (5 per batch). Using agent `cert-deploy-v2` with parallelism 5.

Maria P (infra): Upload done to batch 1/4. Logs:
```
[cert-deploy-v2] node-01: success
[cert-deploy-v2] node-02: success
[cert-deploy-v2] node-03: chain incomplete -> uploaded corrected bundle -> success
```

Elaine (oncall): Re-enabled TLS terminate on canary host gateway-canary-2 to validate full chain. Testing with curl now.

Elaine (oncall): canary test result: 200 ok, ssl connection established. Proceeding to next batch.

IncidentBot: :information_source: Noting on-call handoff scheduled. Elaine handing off to Sanjay in 15m due to upcoming meeting.

Elaine (oncall): Handover notes: remaining 3 batches, keep parallelism at 5, monitor gateway.tls_handshake_failures and gateway.5xx_rate, contact Rajeev if any cert signature mismatch.

Sanjay K: Ack. I'll take over in 15m. Current ETA full fix ~+35m.

Rajeev (security): Postmortem note: rotation automation didn't purge expired intermediates from artifact store; will open infra task to add validation step and expiry check during rotation.

SupportBot: Update posted to customers: prod-gateway TLS degradation — mitigation in progress. Template used: https://docs.redwood.example.com/status/templates/tls-degradation

Maria P (infra): All batches complete. Rolling restart on front nodes to pick up new chain.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Observed handshake failures return to baseline. gateway.5xx_rate back to normal at 1954324200.

Sanjay K: All done. I'll open an incident-ticket and link postmortem.

Elaine (oncall): Thanks team. Quick follow-ups: add expiry alert for intermediate certs, integration test for chain validation in deploy pipeline, update runbook step for atomic chain replace.

Rajeev (security): Adding "verify full chain" check to rotation playbook. Assigning to Maria.

Maria P (infra): On it — PR incoming.

Elaine (oncall): Closing pager. Final impact: ~7k failed req/min during peak for ~25 minutes, ~3 customers had elevated errors, no data loss.

IncidentBot: Incident closed by Sanjay at 1954324600. Postmortem link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026
